name: Girl's Chat ~Wakariaetara~
original_name: ガールズ・チャット ～わかりあえたら～
source:
Main character's younger sister drops a membership card of the chat club "Girls Chat". Protagonist pretends to be his sister and uses membership card to become friends with chat regulars.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/02/vn-of-month-march-2001.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角的妹妹掉落了聊天俱乐部“Girls Chat”的会员卡。主角假扮自己的妹妹，利用会员卡与常聊天的人成为好友。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/02/vn-of-month-march-2001.html]vndbreview[/url]]
